tool_calls.name: lookup_drug_info

args.question: What is Zelvora approved for and how should it be taken?

tool_calls.result:
What Zelvora is for: Zelvora is a prescription tablet for adults (18 and older) with moderate to severe atopic dermatitis (eczema) whose eczema was not well controlled by creams or ointments. It is not approved for children, for other skin conditions, or for any other use.

Who should not take Zelvora: Do not take Zelvora if you are allergic to zelvoritinib or any ingredient in the tablet, or if you have an active serious infection. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding; the effects of Zelvora in pregnancy are not known.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks for confirming! How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since you started it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, good. Have you been able to take it once a day as prescribed?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect, that's great. Do you have any questions about Zelvora I can help with?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No questions. Oh, my ankles have been a bit swollen this week, probably the heat.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for telling me, Maria — I've just passed that to the safety team, who may follow up. If the swelling spreads to your face or throat, or you have trouble breathing or chest pain, please get medical help right away.
